study: MCC pore structure and moisture accessibility
design: Three independent MCC grades at three RH conditions (33, 53, 75%), independent batch replicates; non-nicotine
measurements: DVS EMC/hysteresis; Karl Fischer; DSC confined freezable water; paired envelope and skeletal density with pore-range control
analysis_cautions: Do not calculate PAI unless matched compatible accessible/total pore volumes exist; distinguish swelling vs pores
scale: 3x3x3 = 27 independent preparations before technical replicate measurements

study: MCC x HPC x humidity response-surface discovery
design: 2 MCC grades; 3 HPC loadings chosen after preliminary manufacturability; 3 RH; 3 independent batches; non-nicotine
measurements: Moisture, mechanical cohesion, particle-size, swelling; rheology if material allows
analysis_cautions: Categorical grade + quantitative binder + RH; interaction model; blocked preparation days

study: Flavor identity x RH x aging
design: Control (no flavor), menthol, vanillin; two non-nicotine loading levels where relevant; 3 RH; 0/7/28 days; 3 independent batches
measurements: GC-MS/HPLC flavor retention, transformation products, DVS/KF/aw, colorimetry
analysis_cautions: Separate compound identity from numeric dose; pre-specify nondetect treatment; destructive time point counts
scale: Pre-screen feasibility then power/sample size from variance

study: Nonwoven pouch barrier and seal performance
design: 2–3 publicly purchased unfilled nonwoven pouch fabrics; 3 RH conditioning levels; 3 lots
measurements: Capillary wetting time; fluid flux; wet/dry tensile/seal strength; microscopy; extractables
analysis_cautions: Separate fabric-only from filled-matrix response; standardize specimen area
scale: Full factorial as feasible, independently replicated

measurements: Flavor retention, color, water activity, mass change, chemical transformation
analysis_cautions: Fit kinetic models only after checking residuals and independent holdout; avoid extrapolated shelf life
